correctness.rationale: Exact finite family: seven independent F2 point-evaluation constraints in 21 quintic coefficients leave 2^14-1=16383 equations; geometric smoothness by the unit Jacobian ideal on all three affine charts, with orbit decomposition 139 -> ten smooth orbits totaling 1512. For genus six, counts over F_{2^j}, j=1..6, determine c1..c6 by Newton identities and the remaining six by the Weil functional equation. Tate then distinguishes rational Jacobian isogeny classes. Independently compared the complete unordered sets of ten (c1,...,c6) tuples in this result with the complete earlier theorem; every one matches exactly (different monomial mask encodings do not change the Weil tuples). The earlier exact exhaustive classification corroborates the source arithmetic; the 139-orbit computation itself was not rerun in this audit.
